# Styling modifiers

> Generated from the source doc comments. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `cargo run -p choscorui-api-docs --locked`. The [index](README.md) lists every item. Every example assumes `use choscorui::prelude::*;`.

## Styling modifiers

### `background`

```rust
fn background<M>(self, fill: impl IntoLive<Fill, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Paints `fill` behind the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let note = Text::new("Note")
    .padding(Space::S2)
    .background(ColorRole::Muted);
```

### `border`

```rust
fn border<M>(self, fill: impl IntoLive<Fill, M>, width: f64) -> Styled<Self>
```

Strokes the view's edge inside its bounds.

#### Examples

```rust
let card = Text::new("Card").padding(Space::S4).border(ColorRole::Border, 1.0);
```

### `button_variant`

```rust
fn button_variant<M>(self, variant: impl IntoLive<ButtonVariant, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The variant of buttons in the view that have none of their own.

#### Examples

```rust
let toolbar = HStack::new((
    Button::new("Bold", || {}),
    Button::new("Italic", || {}),
))
.button_variant(ButtonVariant::Outline);
```

### `clip_shape`

```rust
fn clip_shape(self) -> Styled<Self>
```

Clips the content to the view's bounds and corner radius.

#### Examples

```rust
let image = Text::new("Photo").corner_radius(RadiusScale::Lg).clip_shape();
```

### `color_scheme`

```rust
fn color_scheme<M>(self, scheme: impl IntoLive<ColorScheme, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The color scheme of the view and its descendants.

#### Examples

```rust
let panel = Text::new("Dark panel").color_scheme(ColorScheme::Dark);
```

### `control_size`

```rust
fn control_size<M>(self, size: impl IntoLive<ControlSize, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The size of controls in the view that have none of their own.

#### Examples

```rust
let toolbar = HStack::new((
    Button::new("Cut", || {}),
    Button::new("Copy", || {}),
))
.control_size(ControlSize::Sm);
```

### `corner_radius`

```rust
fn corner_radius<M>(self, radius: impl IntoLive<Corner, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Rounds the corners of the view's background, border, and clip.

#### Examples

```rust
let chip = Text::new("Chip")
    .background(ColorRole::Secondary)
    .corner_radius(RadiusScale::Md);
```

### `environment`

```rust
fn environment(self, change: impl Fn(&mut Env) + 'static) -> Styled<Self>
```

Changes the environment of the view's descendants.

#### Examples

```rust
let page = Text::new("Hello").environment(|env| env.set_value(42_u32));
```

### `foreground`

```rust
fn foreground<M>(self, fill: impl IntoLive<Fill, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The color of text in the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let caption = Text::new("Caption").foreground(ColorRole::MutedForeground);
```

### `opacity`

```rust
fn opacity<M>(self, opacity: impl IntoLive<f64, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Fades the view and its content.

#### Examples

```rust
let hint = Text::new("Optional").opacity(0.5);
```

### `recipe`

```rust
fn recipe(self, kind: ControlKind, recipe: Rc<dyn Recipe>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Paints controls of `kind` in the view with `recipe`.

#### Examples

```rust
let save = Button::new("Save", || {}).recipe(ControlKind::Button, Rc::new(DefaultRecipe));
```

### `ring`

```rust
fn ring<M>(self, fill: impl IntoLive<Fill, M>, width: f64) -> Styled<Self>
```

Strokes an outline just outside the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let selected = Text::new("Selected").ring(ColorRole::Ring, 2.0);
```

### `shadow`

```rust
fn shadow<M>(self, shadow: impl IntoLive<Elevation, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Paints a shadow under the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let card = Text::new("Card")
    .background(ColorRole::Card)
    .shadow(ShadowScale::Sm);
```

### `theme`

```rust
fn theme<M>(self, theme: impl IntoLive<(BaseColor, ColorScheme), M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The base color and scheme of the view and its descendants.

#### Examples

```rust
let panel = Text::new("Dark panel").theme((BaseColor::Zinc, ColorScheme::Dark));
```

### `tint`

```rust
fn tint<M>(self, fill: impl IntoLive<Fill, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The accent color of controls in the view: the primary role.

#### Examples

```rust
let form = VStack::new((
    Button::new("Save", || {}),
    Button::new("Cancel", || {}),
))
.tint(Color::rgb8(0x25, 0x63, 0xeb));
```

### `token`

```rust
fn token<M>(self, role: ColorRole, fill: impl IntoLive<Fill, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

Replaces one color token in the view and its descendants.

#### Examples

```rust
let alert = Button::new("Delete", || {})
    .token(ColorRole::Destructive, Color::rgb8(0xb9, 0x1c, 0x1c));
```
